_constructed: Real Claude judgment of the CONSTRUCTED competitor listing above.

reasons.observation: Both titles name the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen); the competitor title only adds 'Wireless Noise-Canceling', which is descriptive.
Both listings have the same brand, Bose (id qHHu).
The Crutchfield URL path 'Bose-QuietComfort-Ultra-Headphones-2nd-Gen-Black' names the 2nd Gen in Black and has no used, refurbished or open-box markers.
The Crutchfield offer condition is 'new'; the title and description show no sign of used, refurbished or open-box.
The canonical IDs differ (mgo7x7F vs XglitcH), but Channel3 can list one product under several IDs, so this is not treated as a mismatch.
The shop's colour options include an odd 'on' label and a URL-encoded 'MIDNIGHT%20VIOLET'. This is minor data noise and does not affect the selected Black variant.

Neither listing is a bundle, multipack or accessory. The Bluetooth version differs between descriptions (5.3 vs 5.4), which is likely a data inconsistency and not a different generation, since both say 2nd Gen.

decision.customer_message: The competitor's listing is the same Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) in Black, and it appears to be a new item, not a bundle or accessory.
